observations: White truck cab with an orange mast-type drilling rig mounted on the rear chassis.
Drilling rig has a lattice mast, hydraulic hoses, pump/engine unit, and a drill head folded back in photo 2.
Truck front grille shows a manufacturer emblem but no clearly readable model name or number in any photo.
Large stylized logo on the side of the mast in photos 0 and 1, but the letters are not clearly legible as a brand name.
Truck appears weathered and dusty; tires, windshield, and body show wear.
No video or close-up of the rig operating, no close-up of hydraulic cylinders or hoses, no paperwork visible.

claims.evidence: Photos show the machine at rest; no running, drilling, or hydraulic operation is shown.
Photos 0-2 show a mast, drill head, hydraulic lines, and pump unit mounted on a truck chassis.
Seller's phrase only; site condition and location cannot be inspected from photos.

risks.risk: Drilling rig engine, pump, or hydraulics may not work
risks.proof: Video of the rig operating and actually drilling a hole

risks.risk: Truck engine may not start or truck may not drive under its own power
risks.proof: Video of the engine starting and the truck moving forward and backward

risks.risk: Hydraulic hoses, cylinders, or seals may be leaking or worn
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all hydraulic hoses, rams, and any visible leaks

risks.risk: Mast, drill head, or welds may be cracked, bent, or fatigued
risks.proof: Detailed photos of the mast truss, welds, joints, and drill head from multiple angles

risks.risk: Ownership or registration papers may be missing
risks.proof: Photos of vehicle registration and proof of ownership documents

proof_requests: Video of the drilling rig operating and drilling
Video of the truck engine starting and the truck driving
Close-up photos of hydraulic hoses, cylinders, and any leaks
Photos of vehicle registration and ownership documents
response.reason: The item is clearly a truck-mounted borehole drilling machine, so it can be priced at its worst case as seen; the seller's working claim is unproven and is therefore priced as not working.
